reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
ABH IL will only reimburse for IMRT planning and delivery when appropriately reported. 
Appropriate reporting includes 
• 
IMRT plan reported no more than once during an eight- week period, even if there is a 
planned "cone down" treatment feature or change in field size. 
• 
IMRT therapy procedures that are considered incidental to the creation of the IMRT plan 
(reported up to two weeks prior to the IMRT plan with the same primary diagnosis code as 
the reported IMRT planning claim line) are not reported separately. 
 
Claims that are submitted will be denied when 
• 
IMRT planning is reported on more than one date within an eight-week period. 
• 
IMRT therapy is reported two weeks prior to the reporting of an IMRT plan and the primary 
diagnosis is the same as any diagnosis reported on the IMRT planning claim line 
 
The medical record documentation is expected to support the specific CPT code(s), ICD-10-CM 
diagnosis codes and modifiers reported.

The 10th revision of the (ICD), a medical classification list by the
World Health Organization (WHO). It contains codes for diseases,
signs and symptoms, abnormal findings, complaints, social
circumstances, and external causes of injury or diseases.

The state administered program that provides health coverage to
millions of Americans, including eligible low-income adults,
children, pregnant women, elderly adults, and people with
disabilities, according to federal requirements. The program is
funded jointly by states and the federal government.

Medicare is a health insurance program for: people aged sixty-
five (65) or older, people under age sixty-five (65) with certain
disabilities, and people of all ages with End-Stage Renal Disease
(permanent kidney failure requiring dialysis or a kidney
transplant).
